title: cacalia glazioviana
intro: Cacalia glazioviana, commonly known as Brazilian Cacalia or Cacalia, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine in Brazil due to its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia glazioviana include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Cacalia glazioviana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential applications in the development of new therapeutic agents.
